+import base64
+import mimetypes
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _image_data(image_path: str):
+    p = Path(image_path)
+    mime = mimetypes.guess_type(p.name)[0] or "image/jpeg"
+    return mime, base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
+
+
+def describe_image(image_path: str) -> str:
+    mime, encoded = _image_data(image_path)
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-4o-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Write a short visual description of this image."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:{mime};base64,{encoded}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text.strip()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: describe_image.py IMAGE_PATH")
+    print(describe_image(sys.argv[1]))
*** End Patch

Task: detects labels or objects in a static image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: detect_image_labels.py
+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request, error
+
+
+def detect_labels(image_path: str, max_labels: int = 10):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")},
+                "features": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "LABEL_DETECTION",
+                        "maxResults": max_labels,
+                    }
+                ],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    req = request.Request(
+        f"https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate?key={api_key}",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except error.HTTPError as e:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Google Cloud Vision API error: {e.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')}") from e
+
+    annotations = data.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("labelAnnotations", [])
+    return [
+        {
+            "description": item.get("description"),
+            "score": item.get("score"),
+            "mid": item.get("mid"),
+        }
+        for item in annotations
+    ]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Detect labels in a static image using Google Cloud Vision API.")
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-labels", type=int, default=10)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    labels = detect_labels(args.image_path, args.max_labels)
+    json.dump(labels, sys.stdout, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
